d:
Set against the beautiful snow-covered mountains, enjoy the heart-touching melody “Sacchi Mohabbat” from the film Manmarziyaan. Sung by Shahid Mallya & Jonita Gandhi, composed by Amit Trivedi and written by Shellee.
Singers: Shahid Mallya & Jonita Gandhi
Music: Amit Trivedi
Lyrics: Shellee
Produced & Arranged By: Amit Trivedi
Recording Engineers (A T Studios Mumbai): Abhishek Sortey & Urmila Sutar
Assisted By: Firoz Shaikh
Mixed & Mastered By: Shadab Rayeen (A T Studios & New Edge Mumbai)
